industrial_colonies:processing/iron/blas.comment: Carbon-fueled blast reduction leaves real slag; 75 mB is three 25 mB nuggets.

industrial_colonies:processing/copper/wa.comment: Copper alone uses simple Fan + Water washing.

industrial_colonies:processing/tin/gravi.comment: Basin agitation separates dense cassiterite; intentionally NOT fan washing.

industrial_colonies:processing/cinnabar/.comment: Unheated regular mixer, four dust batch; sulfur trace never competes with refining.

industrial_colonies:processing/alloys/br.comment: Intentional alloys belong to the Mixer, not Foundry tanks.

industrial_colonies:processing/pgm/crude.comment: ONE weighted result per successful crude roll, never three independent chances.

industrial_colonies:processing/pgm/iridi.comment: Forty rare 25 mB fragments electrically consolidate into one 1000 mB Iridium ingot; no unattainable 1800-degree Foundry melt and no value rounding.

industrial_colonies:processing/zinc/leac.comment: Sulfide dissolution owns Zinc recovery; no Copper-style washing shortcut.

industrial_colonies:processing/zinc/dire.comment: Brute-force recovery is substantially worse than leaching; its native Zinc temperature is reachable on early solid fuel.

industrial_colonies:processing/lead/roas.comment: Oxidative roasting; sulfur recovery is trace-level, never a refinery substitute.

industrial_colonies:processing/lead/puri.comment: Optional controlled-grade Lead for shielding and chemical hardware, not another ore multiplier.

industrial_colonies:processing/nickel/se.comment: Nickel precipitates first; the remaining dilute mother liquor is the only low-yield Cobalt branch.

industrial_colonies:processing/cobalt/di.comment: A single small chance, not guaranteed Cobalt from every Pentlandite and not a rerollable solution.

industrial_colonies:processing/nickel/cr.comment: Intentionally nickel-only: no Cobalt item or mixed Ni/Co solution is produced.

industrial_colonies:processing/cobalt/cr.comment: The reverse asymmetry is intentional: Cobalt-rich ore can contain a smaller Nickel fraction.

industrial_colonies:processing/aluminum/.comment: Alumina requires powered vat electrodes. Bauxite cannot be directly melted into Aluminum.

industrial_colonies:processing/magnesium.comment: Electrical recovery returns Magnesium and Chlorine; the Titanium loop returns only the MgCl2 it consumed as Magnesium.

industrial_colonies:processing/titanium/.comment: Two Magnesium units become two electrolyzer batches of MgCl2; recovery costs energy and never multiplies Magnesium.
Powered refractory consolidation is available before Industrial Iron, whose construction consumes Titanium.

industrial_colonies:processing/tungsten/.comment: Tungsten requires high-energy sintering; ordinary Foundry melting must not bypass this powder-consolidation stage.

industrial_colonies:processing/chromium/.comment: ONLY the Industrial Iron encased fan can separate this conditioned feed; base and Weathered Iron fans must reject it. Native fan processing uses Create global timing, not a per-recipe duration field.

industrial_colonies:processing/lithium/m.comment: The molten endpoint casts canonical TFMG Lithium; the metal was electrically reduced before melting.

industrial_colonies:processing/phosphate.comment: A consumed phosphate/nitrate feed gives an early useful chemical product without elemental Phosphorus.
Elemental Phosphorus is a later high-temperature carbon reduction, not the first washing output.

industrial_colonies:processing/graphite/.comment: High-purity industrial Carbon is electrode/refractory feed, not fuel progression.

industrial_colonies:processing/boron/con.comment: Fifty chemically reduced 60 mB Boron fractions consolidate into three 1000 mB ingots. Native Foundry fuel stops at 1500, so electrical consolidation replaces an unreachable 2000-degree melt.

industrial_colonies:processing/uranium/n.comment: Refined feed enters existing NuclearCraft isotope separation; no direct ore-to-ingot or fuel recipe is introduced.

industrial_colonies:processing/thorium/n.comment: Refined feed enters existing NuclearCraft isotope separation; no direct ore-to-ingot or fuel recipe is introduced.

industrial_colonies:processing/pgm/plati.comment: Across a four-rock batch, expected small fractions retain the 70/25/5 bias; Iridium is a refractory residue, not a ready metal.

industrial_colonies:processing/pgm/conso.comment: Twenty reduced 50 mB fractions consolidate into one 1000 mB ingot with native electrical equipment; no nonexistent high-temperature Foundry fuel is required.
Twenty reduced 50 mB fractions consolidate into one 1000 mB ingot with native electrical equipment; no nonexistent high-temperature Foundry fuel is required.
The rare refractory fraction needs the harshest purification and high-energy final consolidation.

industrial_colonies:processing/reagents/.comment: Mekanism hydrogen chemical supplies the existing TFMG hydrogen fluid instead of a duplicate custom gas.
One existing Salt becomes 15 mB Brine, matching native Mekanism salt recovery exactly; no new sediment or free-salt route.
Powered two-electrode TFMG vat supplies the first caustic before Aluminum-dependent electronics. Two mined Salt units per hydroxide; not hand-crafting or smelting.
Reuse NuclearCraft sodium hydroxide. Later Mekanism brine electrolysis uses 10 mB Brine per Sodium and improves reagent recovery over the 30 mB bootstrap.
Sulfur → Mekanism SO2 → SO3; final hydration still belongs to the Chemical Vat and outputs canonical TFMG acid.

industrial_colonies:processing/sulfur/re.comment: Optional finite-feed refinery desulfurization, leaving TFMG crude/heavy distillation recipes untouched.
Oil is deliberately the bulk Sulfur source; sulfide-rock byproducts are only small chance traces.

industrial_colonies:processing/sulfur/de.comment: Native heavy-oil product ratios are retained. The recirculated heavy fraction stays desulfurized and cannot return to the sulfur extractor; native refining is not overridden.

industrial_colonies:processing/silicon/s.comment: Abundant sand is a feedstock, not instantly usable semiconductor silicon.

industrial_colonies:processing/silicon/c.comment: High-temperature carbothermal reduction provides only metallurgical grade.
Chemical cleanup is distinct from the high-temperature reduction.

industrial_colonies:processing/silicon/w.comment: High-purity silicon feeds the already-registered wafer; no duplicate wafer item.

industrial_colonies:processing/radiance/.comment: Sixteen Ti plus sixteen W form one refractory lattice; no electronics shortcut.
Scarce iridium is mandatory; all three PGM industries feed the capstone.

Native PRC energy_required is EXTRA JOULES PER TICK: 1600 x 12500 / installed 2.5 J per FE = 8 million extra FE before upgrades. Total 1605 J/t fits its native 2000 J buffer; machine upgrades retain their normal effects.
One final Radiance from costly precursor; extreme electrical consolidation, no Allthemodium.

industrial_colonies:processing/coal/coke.comment: An additional coke-oven feed, not a rewrite of native Coal fuel, coking, oil or power.

industrial_colonies:processing/coal/tar_.comment: Coal Tar is a finite chemical feedstock; no coal-derived sulfur farm.
